title: Sandevistan (Cyperpunk)
description: Mod that adds the Sandevistan from the cyperpunk universe
body:
Join the discord server to support the mod [https://discord.gg/bfb4gANFZ4](https://discord.gg/bfb4gANFZ4)

This mod adds the Sandevistan, a powerful cybernetic chestplate that lets players activate a burst of extreme speed with Z.

When activated, the world freezes around you while you move freely, leaving colorful afterimages behind as you cut through mobs, players, and the battlefield.

The mod includes a full crafting recipe for the Sandevistan using new custom items: Neural Circuit, Heat Sink, and Servo Bundle. It also includes recipe progression, advancements, cooldowns, overuse danger, and configurable balance settings.

Using the Sandevistan too often builds up usage. At first, the drawback is mostly longer cooldowns, but pushing it too far can cause slowness, weakness, blindness, nausea, mining fatigue, darkness, and even damage.

While the Sandevistan is active, you cannot take damage from normal sources. Instead, the damage is stored and applied after the effect ends. However, other players or mobs using a Sandevistan at the same time can still fight you normally.

You can also run across water while active, fight other Sandevistan users, and rarely find mobs that spawn with one equipped.

Settings can be changed under the Mods tab if you press the config button. Only the server owner or opped players can change the Sandevistan settings.

If this mod gets enough downloads, I might add more content in the future.
